## Overview

This document summarizes the staff survey on REDCap-based PROMs outputs and saves tables and figures for the manuscript appendix.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tinytable)
library(grid)

source(here("R", "io.R"))

output_dir <- here("output", "06_redcap_staff_survey")
figure_dir <- here(output_dir, "figures")

ensure_dir(output_dir)
ensure_dir(figure_dir)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
redcap_staff_survey <- read.csv(
  here("data", "clean", "UmfrageQoLInDerMedOn_DATA_2026-06-21_1421.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(redcap_staff_survey)[1] <- "record_id"
redcap_staff_survey$survey_timestamp <- as.POSIXct(
  redcap_staff_survey$umfrage_zur_qol_timestamp,
  tz = "Europe/Zurich"
)

survey_group_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Oncology nursing",
  "2" = "Physicians",
  "3" = "Psycho-oncology"
)
survey_group_levels <- c("Physicians", "Oncology nursing", "Psycho-oncology")
survey_usefulness_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Very useful",
  "2" = "Useful",
  "3" = "Slightly useful",
  "4" = "Not useful",
  "5" = "Do not know"
)
survey_use_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Very often",
  "2" = "Often",
  "3" = "Rarely",
  "4" = "Never"
)

redcap_staff_survey$group_label <- factor(
  survey_group_labels[as.character(redcap_staff_survey$group)],
  levels = survey_group_levels
)
```

```{r}
#| label: survey-summaries
redcap_survey_metadata <- tibble(
  name = c("n", "first_date", "last_date"),
  value = c(
    as.character(nrow(redcap_staff_survey)),
    as.character(min(as.Date(redcap_staff_survey$survey_timestamp))),
    as.character(max(as.Date(redcap_staff_survey$survey_timestamp)))
  )
)

redcap_survey_n <- nrow(redcap_staff_survey)

redcap_survey_group_summary <- as.data.frame(
  table(redcap_staff_survey$group_label),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
names(redcap_survey_group_summary) <- c("group", "n")
redcap_survey_group_summary$pct <- redcap_survey_group_summary$n / redcap_survey_n
redcap_survey_group_summary$percent <- percent(redcap_survey_group_summary$pct, accuracy = 1)

survey_acceptability_row <- function(metric, variable, positive_values = c(1, 2)) {
  observed <- !is.na(redcap_staff_survey[[variable]])
  n_positive <- sum(redcap_staff_survey[[variable]][observed] %in% positive_values)
  total <- sum(observed)
  data.frame(
    metric = metric,
    n = n_positive,
    total = total,
    pct = n_positive / total,
    percent = percent(n_positive / total, accuracy = 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

redcap_survey_acceptability_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  list(
    survey_acceptability_row("Initial visit: useful or very useful", "baseline_value"),
    survey_acceptability_row("Initial visit: integrated often or very often", "baseline_use"),
    survey_acceptability_row("Follow-up: useful or very useful", "fu_value"),
    survey_acceptability_row("Follow-up: integrated often or very often", "fu_use")
  )
)

survey_acceptability_by_group <- function(metric, variable, positive_values = c(1, 2)) {
  rows <- lapply(survey_group_levels, function(group) {
    observed <- !is.na(redcap_staff_survey$group_label) &
      redcap_staff_survey$group_label == group &
      !is.na(redcap_staff_survey[[variable]])
    total <- sum(observed)
    n_positive <- sum(redcap_staff_survey[[variable]][observed] %in% positive_values)
    data.frame(
      group = group,
      metric = metric,
      n = n_positive,
      total = total,
      pct = n_positive / total,
      percent = percent(n_positive / total, accuracy = 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

redcap_survey_group_acceptability <- do.call(
  rbind,
  list(
    survey_acceptability_by_group("Initial visit: useful or very useful", "baseline_value"),
    survey_acceptability_by_group("Initial visit: integrated often or very often", "baseline_use"),
    survey_acceptability_by_group("Follow-up: useful or very useful", "fu_value"),
    survey_acceptability_by_group("Follow-up: integrated often or very often", "fu_use")
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: response-distributions
redcap_survey_group_plot_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(
    redcap_survey_group_summary$group,
    " (n=",
    redcap_survey_group_summary$n,
    ")"
  ),
  redcap_survey_group_summary$group
)

summarize_survey_responses <- function(variable, setting, domain, labels) {
  tab <- as.data.frame(
    table(
      group = redcap_staff_survey$group_label,
      code = factor(
        as.character(redcap_staff_survey[[variable]]),
        levels = names(labels)
      )
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(tab)[3] <- "n"
  tab$setting <- setting
  tab$domain <- domain
  tab$response <- factor(labels[as.character(tab$code)], levels = unname(labels))
  tab$total <- redcap_survey_group_summary$n[
    match(tab$group, redcap_survey_group_summary$group)
  ]
  tab$pct <- tab$n / tab$total
  tab$group_plot_label <- factor(
    redcap_survey_group_plot_labels[as.character(tab$group)],
    levels = redcap_survey_group_plot_labels[survey_group_levels]
  )
  tab
}

redcap_survey_usefulness_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  list(
    summarize_survey_responses(
      "baseline_value",
      "Initial visit",
      "Perceived usefulness",
      survey_usefulness_labels
    ),
    summarize_survey_responses(
      "fu_value",
      "Follow-up",
      "Perceived usefulness",
      survey_usefulness_labels
    )
  )
)
redcap_survey_usefulness_summary$setting <- factor(
  redcap_survey_usefulness_summary$setting,
  levels = c("Initial visit", "Follow-up")
)

redcap_survey_use_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  list(
    summarize_survey_responses(
      "baseline_use",
      "Initial visit",
      "Integration into consultation",
      survey_use_labels
    ),
    summarize_survey_responses(
      "fu_use",
      "Follow-up",
      "Integration into consultation",
      survey_use_labels
    )
  )
)
redcap_survey_use_summary$setting <- factor(
  redcap_survey_use_summary$setting,
  levels = c("Initial visit", "Follow-up")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: save-tables
write_parquet(redcap_survey_metadata, here(output_dir, "metadata.parquet"))
write_parquet(redcap_survey_group_summary, here(output_dir, "group_summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(redcap_survey_acceptability_summary, here(output_dir, "acceptability_summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(redcap_survey_group_acceptability, here(output_dir, "group_acceptability.parquet"))
write_parquet(redcap_survey_usefulness_summary, here(output_dir, "usefulness_response_summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(redcap_survey_use_summary, here(output_dir, "use_response_summary.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: figures
survey_usefulness_colors <- c(
  "Very useful" = "#2166AC",
  "Useful" = "#67A9CF",
  "Slightly useful" = "#FDB863",
  "Not useful" = "#B2182B",
  "Do not know" = "#A6A6A6"
)
survey_use_colors <- c(
  "Very often" = "#1B7837",
  "Often" = "#7FBF7B",
  "Rarely" = "#F1A340",
  "Never" = "#B2182B"
)

redcap_survey_usefulness_plot <- ggplot(
  redcap_survey_usefulness_summary,
  aes(x = group_plot_label, y = pct, fill = response)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(vars(setting), nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = survey_usefulness_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

redcap_survey_use_plot <- ggplot(
  redcap_survey_use_summary,
  aes(x = group_plot_label, y = pct, fill = response)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(vars(setting), nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = survey_use_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

save_plot_dual(
  redcap_survey_usefulness_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "usefulness"),
  width = 8,
  height = 4
)
save_plot_dual(
  redcap_survey_use_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "integration"),
  width = 8,
  height = 4
)
```

## Overall Acceptability

```{r}
redcap_survey_acceptability_table <- redcap_survey_acceptability_summary
redcap_survey_acceptability_table$n_total <- paste0(
  redcap_survey_acceptability_table$n,
  "/",
  redcap_survey_acceptability_table$total
)

redcap_survey_acceptability_table <- redcap_survey_acceptability_table[, c("metric", "n_total", "percent")]
names(redcap_survey_acceptability_table) <- c("Survey result", "n/total", "Percent")

tt(redcap_survey_acceptability_table)
```

redcap_survey_group_acceptability_table <- redcap_survey_group_acceptability
redcap_survey_group_acceptability_table$n_total <- paste0(

redcap_survey_group_acceptability_table <- redcap_survey_group_acceptability_table[

]
names(redcap_survey_group_acceptability_table) <- c(

tt(redcap_survey_group_acceptability_table)
